G1473.b:
⟪ἐγώ⟫, gen, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, pers. pron. ⟪I⟫.
⟪(a)⟫ The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in ⟦Matthew 3:11|Mt 3:11⟧, ⟦Mark 1:8|Mk 1:8⟧, ⟦Luke 3:16|Lk 3:16⟧, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as ⟦Matthew 10:16|Mt 10:16⟧, ⟦John 10:17|Jo 10:17⟧; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. ⁨הִנֵּנִי⁩, cf. ⟦1 Samuel 3:8|I Ki 3:8⟧), ⟦Acts 9:10|Ac 9:10⟧; ἐ. (like Heb. ⁨אֲנִי⁩), ⟪I am⟫, ⟦John 1:23|Jo 1:23 (LXX)⟧, ⟦Acts 7:32|Ac 7:32 (LXX)⟧.
⟪(b)⟫ The enclitic forms (v. supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, ⟦John 14:20|Jo 14:20⟧; μου τ. λόγους, ⟦Matthew 7:24|Mt 7:24⟧; ὀπίσω μου, ⟦Matthew 3:11|Mt 3:11⟧; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ⟦Matthew 3:11|ib.⟧; λέγει μοι, ⟦Revelation 5:5|Re 5:5⟧; also with the prep. πρός, as ⟦Mark 9:19|Mk 9:19⟧, al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι' ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as ⟦Luke 10:16|Lk 10:16⟧, ⟦John 7:23|Jo 7:23⟧, ⟦Mark 14:7|Mk 14:7⟧, al.
⟪(c)⟫ The gen. μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, ⟦Matthew 2:6|Mt 2:6⟧; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, ⟦Mark 9:24|Mk 9:24⟧.
⟪(d)⟫ τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. ⁨וָלָךְ מַה־לִי⁩, ⟦Judges 11:12|Jg 11:12⟧, al.), i.e. ⟪what have we in common⟫: ⟦Matthew 8:29|Mt 8:29⟧, ⟦Mark 1:24|Mk 1:24⟧ ⟦Mark 5:7|5:7⟧, ⟦Luke 8:28|Lk 8:28⟧, ⟦John 2:4|Jo 2:4⟧; τί γάρ μοι, ⟦1 Corinthians 5:2|I Co 5:2⟧.
⟪(e)⟫ The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (v. M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).
⟪(f)⟫ κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ, ⟪and I, even I, I also⟫: ⟦Matthew 2:8|Mt 2:8⟧, ⟦Luke 2:48|Lk 2:48⟧, ⟦John 6:56|Jo 6:56⟧, ⟦Romans 3:7|Ro 3:7⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:40|I Co 7:40⟧, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, ⟪both . . . and⟫, ⟦John 7:28|Jo 7:28⟧.
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G1487.b:
⟪εἰ⟫, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
⟪I.⟫ Conditional, ⟪if⟫;
	⟪1.⟫ c. indic., expressing a general assumption;
		⟪(a)⟫ pres.: seq. indic, pres., ⟦Matthew 11:14|Mt 11:14⟧, ⟦Romans 8:25|Ro 8:25⟧, al.; seq. imperat., ⟦Mark 4:23|Mk 4:23⟧ ⟦Mark 9:22|9:22⟧, ⟦John 15:18|Jo 15:18⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:9|I Co 7:9⟧, al.; seq. fut. indic., ⟦Luke 16:31|Lk 16:31⟧, ⟦Romans 8:11|Ro 8:11⟧, al.; seq. pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, ⟦Matthew 12:26|Mt 12:26⟧, ⟦Romans 4:14|Ro 4:14⟧, al.; similarly, seq. impf., ⟦Luke 17:6|Lk 17:6⟧, ⟦John 8:39|Jo 8:39⟧; seq. quæst., ⟦Matthew 6:23|Mt 6:23⟧, ⟦John 5:47|Jo 5:47⟧ ⟦John 7:23|7:23⟧ ⟦John 8:46|8:46⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:20|I Pe 2:20⟧;
		⟪(b)⟫ fut.: ⟦Matthew 26:33|Mt 26:33⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:20|I Pe 2:20⟧;
		⟪(c)⟫ pf.: ⟦John 11:12|Jo 11:12⟧, ⟦Romans 6:5|Ro 6:5⟧, al.;
		⟪(d)⟫ aor.: ⟦Luke 16:11|Lk 16:11⟧ ⟦Luke 19:8|19:8⟧, ⟦John 13:32|Jo 13:32⟧, ⟦John 18:23|18:23⟧, ⟦Revelation 20:15|Re 20:15⟧, al.
	⟪2.⟫ Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: ⟦Matthew 12:28|Mt 12:28⟧, ⟦John 7:4|Jo 7:4⟧, ⟦Romans 5:17|Ro 5:17⟧, al.
	⟪3.⟫ Of an unfulfilled condition, c. indic, impf., aor. or plpf., seq. ἄν, c. imp. or aor. (v.s. ἄν, I, i).
	⟪4.⟫ C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: ⟦Mark 15:44|Mk 15:44⟧, ⟦1 John 3:13|I Jo 3:13⟧, al.
	⟪5.⟫ C. indic., as in LXX (⟦Numbers 14:30|Nu 14:3o⟧, ⟦1 Samuel 14:45|I Ki 14:45⟧, al. = Heb. ⁨אִם⁩), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): ⟦Mark 8:12|Mk 8:12⟧, ⟦Hebrews 3:11|He 3:11⟧ (LXX) ⟦Hebrews 4:3|4:3⟧ (LXX).
	⟪6.⟫ Rarely (cl.) c. optat., to express a merely possible condition: ⟦Acts 24:19|Ac 24:19⟧ ⟦Acts 27:39|27:39⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 14:10|I Co 14:10⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 15:37|15:37⟧, I Pe3:14, 17.
⟪II.⟫ Interrogative, ⟪if, whether⟫.
	⟪1.⟫ As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: c. indic. pres., ⟦Matthew 26:63|Mt 26:63⟧, ⟦Mark 15:36|Mk 15:36⟧, ⟦Acts 19:2|Ac 19:2⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 13:5|II Co 13:5⟧, al.; fut., ⟦Mark 3:2|Mk 3:2⟧, ⟦Acts 8:22|Ac 8:22⟧, al.; aor., ⟦Mark 15:44|Mk 15:44⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 1:16|I Co 1:16⟧, al.; c. subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), ⟦Philippians 3:12|Phl 3:12⟧.
	⟪2.⟫ As in LXX (= Heb. ⁨אִם⁩ and interrog. ⁨הֲ⁩, ⟦Genesis 17:17|Ge 17:17⟧, al.; v. WM, 639 f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: ⟦Mark 8:23|Mk 8:23⟧ (Tr., WH, txt.), ⟦Luke 13:23|Lk 13:23⟧, ⟦Luke 22:49|22:49⟧, ⟦Acts 19:2|Ac 19:2⟧, al.
⟪III.⟫ With other particles.
	⟪1.⟫ εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, v.s. ἄρα, γε.
	⟪2.⟫ εἰ δὲ καί, ⟪but if also⟫: ⟦Luke 11:18|Lk 11:18⟧; ⟪but even if⟫, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:7|I Co 4:7⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 4:3|II Co 4:3⟧ ⟦2 Corinthians 11:16|11:16⟧.
	⟪3.⟫ εἰ δὲ μή, ⟪but if not, but if otherwise⟫: ⟦Mark 2:21|Mk 2:21⟧, ⟦Mark 2:22|22⟧, ⟦John 14:2|Jo 14:2⟧, ⟦Revelation 2:5|Re 2:5⟧, al.
	⟪4.⟫ εἰ καί, ⟪if even, if also, although⟫: ⟦Mark 14:29|Mk 14:29⟧, ⟦Luke 11:8|Lk 11:8⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:21|I Co 7:21⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 4:16|II Co 4:16⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:17|Phl 2:17⟧, al.
	⟪5.⟫ καὶ εἰ, ⟪even if⟫, v.s. καί
	⟪6.⟫ εἰ μή, ⟪if not, unless, except, but only⟫: ⟦Matthew 24:22|Mt 24:22⟧, ⟦Mark 2:26|Mk 2:26⟧ ⟦Mark 6:5|6:5⟧, ⟦John 9:33|Jo 9:33⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:17|I Co 7:17⟧ (⟪only⟫), ⟦Galatians 1:19|Ga 1:19⟧ (cf. ἐὰν μή, ⟦Galatians 2:16|2:16⟧; v. Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), ⟦1 Corinthians 14:5|I Co 14:5⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 15:2|15:2⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 5:19|I Ti 5:19⟧.
	⟪7.⟫ εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, ⟪surely⟫ (⟦Ezekiel 33:27|Ez 33:27⟧, al.): ⟦Hebrews 6:14|He 6:14⟧.
	⟪8.⟫ εἴ πως, ⟪if haply⟫: ⟦Acts 27:12|Ac 27:12⟧, ⟦Romans 1:10|Ro 1:10⟧.
	⟪9.⟫ εἴτε . . . εἴτε, ⟪whether . . . or⟫: ⟦Romans 12:6|Ro 12:6-8⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 3:22|I Co 3:22⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 13:8|13:8⟧, al.
